notes: Historical FYs used: 2023-2025 (last 3 completed fiscal years for NEE with Dec 31 year-end). ([stockanalysis.com](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/nee/financials/))

Data extraction method: revenue/EBIT/D&A and capex/NWC inputs were taken from StockAnalysis (reported in millions) and converted to full USD units (x1,000,000). ([stockanalysis.com](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/nee/financials/))
EBIT definition: Operating Income from the income statement (StockAnalysis 'Operating Income'). ([stockanalysis.com](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/nee/financials/))
D&A definition: 'Depreciation & Amortization Expenses' from the income statement (not cash-flow add-back line). ([stockanalysis.com](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/nee/financials/))

Capex definition: 'Capital Expenditures' from the cash flow statement; reported as absolute positive values for modeling. ([stockanalysis.com](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/nee/financials/cash-flow-statement/))

NWC definition (explicit): (Total Current Assets - Cash & Short-Term Investments) - (Total Current Liabilities - Short-Term Debt - Current Portion of Long-Term Debt). Computed from StockAnalysis balance-sheet line items; negative NWC reflects debt-funded current liabilities common in regulated/utility working-capital structures. ([stockanalysis.com](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/nee/financials/balance-sheet/))

Tax rate: base-case tax_rate=0.13 is an assumption because effective tax rate can be volatile year-to-year (tax credits/benefits). This is a normalized DCF input, not a direct FY-2025 effective rate. ([stockanalysis.com](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/nee/financials/))

WACC: wacc=0.065 is an estimate using CAPM with beta from Yahoo Finance (0.73) and an implied cost-of-debt derived from interest expense vs. total debt from the same financial feed; treat as a model input, not a company-reported number. ([finance.yahoo.com](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/NEE/?utm_source=openai))

Terminal assumptions: terminal_growth=0.023 and exit multiple 13.52 are selected to be consistent with utility-peer valuation levels (average EV/EBITDA from selected peers). ([stockanalysis.com](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/duk/statistics/))

Comps limitation: EV/Sales and EV/EBITDA and forward P/E values are taken from StockAnalysis 'Enterprise Valuation' and 'Forward PE' sections; these are used as proxies for EV/NTM Revenue, EV/NTM EBITDA, and P/E NTM. ([stockanalysis.com](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/duk/statistics/))

NOLs: nol_balance is set to null because a reliable extracted balance/carryforward figure for modeling was not obtained within the accessible source set; nol_utilization_pct remains set to 0.80 per the prompt default.

([investor.nexteraenergy.com](https://www.investor.nexteraenergy.com/~/media/Files/N/NEE-IR/reports-and-fillings/quarterly-earnings/2025/Q4%202025/2026-0127%20NEEQ42025News%20Release%20vF.pdf))

NEER origination and commissioning pace (backlog growth and placed-into-service volume) can move expectations for contracted earnings. ([investor.nexteraenergy.com](https://www.investor.nexteraenergy.com/~/media/Files/N/NEE-IR/reports-and-fillings/quarterly-earnings/2025/Q4%202025/2026-0127%20NEEQ42025News%20Release%20vF.pdf))

Progress on nuclear/contracting developments (e.g., project recommissioning and associated power purchase agreements discussed by the company). ([investor.nexteraenergy.com](https://www.investor.nexteraenergy.com/~/media/Files/N/NEE-IR/reports-and-fillings/quarterly-earnings/2025/Q4%202025/2026-0127%20NEEQ42025News%20Release%20vF.pdf))
company_overview: NextEra Energy is a U.S. energy infrastructure company with a regulated electric utility business (Florida Power & Light) and a competitive generation and storage development business (NextEra Energy Resources). ([investor.nexteraenergy.com](https://www.investor.nexteraenergy.com/~/media/Files/N/NEE-IR/reports-and-fillings/quarterly-earnings/2025/Q4%202025/2026-0127%20NEEQ42025News%20Release%20vF.pdf))

FPL provides reliable electricity to customers in Florida with capital investment programs under regulatory frameworks. ([investor.nexteraenergy.com](https://www.investor.nexteraenergy.com/~/media/Files/N/NEE-IR/reports-and-fillings/quarterly-earnings/2025/Q4%202025/2026-0127%20NEEQ42025News%20Release%20vF.pdf))

NextEra Energy Resources develops and brings online renewable generation and battery storage and reports backlog/origination growth as key performance metrics. ([investor.nexteraenergy.com](https://www.investor.nexteraenergy.com/~/media/Files/N/NEE-IR/reports-and-fillings/quarterly-earnings/2025/Q4%202025/2026-0127%20NEEQ42025News%20Release%20vF.pdf))
current_context: Full-year 2025: adjusted earnings were $7.683 billion ($3.71 per share) vs. $7.063 billion ($3.43 per share) in 2024. ([investor.nexteraenergy.com](https://www.investor.nexteraenergy.com/~/media/Files/N/NEE-IR/reports-and-fillings/quarterly-earnings/2025/Q4%202025/2026-0127%20NEEQ42025News%20Release%20vF.pdf))

2026 outlook: adjusted EPS guidance reaffirmed at $3.92 to $4.02. ([investor.nexteraenergy.com](https://www.investor.nexteraenergy.com/~/media/Files/N/NEE-IR/reports-and-fillings/quarterly-earnings/2025/Q4%202025/2026-0127%20NEEQ42025News%20Release%20vF.pdf))

Operational updates: FPL reported regulatory capital employed growth of ~8.1% in 2025 and NextEra Energy Resources added ~13.5 GW to backlog origination in 2025. ([investor.nexteraenergy.com](https://www.investor.nexteraenergy.com/~/media/Files/N/NEE-IR/reports-and-fillings/quarterly-earnings/2025/Q4%202025/2026-0127%20NEEQ42025News%20Release%20vF.pdf))

Company frames long-term EPS growth as visible and balanced between regulated and long-term contracted businesses. ([investor.nexteraenergy.com](https://www.investor.nexteraenergy.com/~/media/Files/N/NEE-IR/reports-and-fillings/quarterly-earnings/2025/Q4%202025/2026-0127%20NEEQ42025News%20Release%20vF.pdf))
investment_highlights: Base-case revenue growth assumes continued scaling of FPL-related regulatory capital and contracted/long-term contracted generation additions from NEER within a stable utility earnings framework. ([investor.nexteraenergy.com](https://www.investor.nexteraenergy.com/~/media/Files/N/NEE-IR/reports-and-fillings/quarterly-earnings/2025/Q4%202025/2026-0127%20NEEQ42025News%20Release%20vF.pdf))

EBIT margin is held near the post-2024 range (base-case ~0.31 by 2030) to reflect utility-style operating leverage without assuming sudden step-changes. ([stockanalysis.com](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/nee/financials/))

High reinvestment intensity is captured via capex at ~0.326 of sales and D&A at ~0.223 of sales, consistent with observed historical capital turnover. ([stockanalysis.com](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/nee/financials/cash-flow-statement/))

Working capital is modeled as consistently negative (base-case ~-0.181 of sales) using an explicit NWC definition that excludes cash and interest-bearing debt items from current assets/liabilities. ([stockanalysis.com](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/nee/financials/balance-sheet/))

Terminal value uses a reasonable exit multiple calibrated to large regulated utility peer valuation benchmarks (average EV/EBITDA). ([stockanalysis.com](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/duk/statistics/))
key_risks: Regulatory and policy risk: changes to allowed returns, cost recovery, or incentives for renewables/storage could pressure margins and cash flows. ([investor.nexteraenergy.com](https://www.investor.nexteraenergy.com/~/media/Files/N/NEE-IR/reports-and-fillings/quarterly-earnings/2025/Q4%202025/2026-0127%20NEEQ42025News%20Release%20vF.pdf))

Execution risk: construction delays, cost inflation, and supply-chain constraints affecting capital projects and contracted generation delivery. ([investor.nexteraenergy.com](https://www.investor.nexteraenergy.com/~/media/Files/N/NEE-IR/reports-and-fillings/quarterly-earnings/2025/Q4%202025/2026-0127%20NEEQ42025News%20Release%20vF.pdf))

Tax/financing risk: lower than expected tax benefits or changes in credit regimes could impact effective tax rate and after-tax profitability. ([investor.nexteraenergy.com](https://www.investor.nexteraenergy.com/~/media/Files/N/NEE-IR/investor-materials/shareholder-resources/2025/2024%20NEE%20Annual%20Report.pdf?utm_source=openai))

Working-capital volatility from timing of receivables/payables and regulatory true-ups could deviate from the historical negative-NWC pattern. ([stockanalysis.com](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/nee/financials/balance-sheet/))
